title: CreativeBlockPlus
description: Prevents players from placing blocks with stored NBT data
body:
# CreativeBlock+

A Modern day plugin to prevent blocks to be spawned with stored NBT data. It works for both Survival and Creative.

## NOTE
There is NO config file! This is just a standalone version of the plugin. It will receive later updates.
